zh.title: 精确率算对了，为什么报告仍可能没有证据？
zh.summary: 数字的计算正确性与证据适用性是两道检查。论文中的轨迹归因案例、独立维护者的指标撤回记录和内部评分探针，共同提示验收者核对对象、分母、版本与时间角色。

en.title: Correct precision, unsupported report: what a metric must be tied to
en.summary: Correct arithmetic and applicable evidence are separate checks. A trajectory study, a separately authored metrics retraction and an internal scoring probe motivate checking object, denominator, revision and temporal role.
